The company says its founders have shaped the civil engineering construction landscape for more than 20 years, and it holds Level 2 BBBEE accreditation. It describes its business as sustainable and says it prioritises the well-being of its team, which it presents as what sets it apart.

The website publishes a list of references from previous projects, along with a list of past and current projects. Prospective clients are invited to get in touch to discuss their next project. The company's contact address is listed as Plot 80 Altha Street, Raslouw, Centurion.

Liebner Engravers was founded in 1979 and provides professional engraving services and custom engraved products. The business engraves trophies, plaques, nameplates, badges, name tags, brass signage, embossers, jewellery items, industrial plaques and corporate awards and logos.

According to its website, it can work on materials including leather, soap, marble, wood, rubber, Perspex and cardboard, as well as metals such as stainless steel, brass and anodized aluminium. The business is now run by a couple with many years of experience engraving and manufacturing custom-designed items. Its stated approach is to maintain high standards, adopt new ideas and take pride in its work, with a focus on quality and customer service.

LNR Accountants has offered tax and accounting advisory services since 2003, serving individuals as well as small and large businesses. Its services include accounting, bookkeeping, payroll, CIPC and Master of the High Court work, taxation, trusts, wills and testaments, and advice on business structures.

The firm says it works with local and international clients and tailors its services to each client's needs in a caring, family-based environment where relationships are fostered. Continual training and development are part of its approach to maintaining service delivery, and its stated goal is to help individuals and companies maximise their financial potential. The offices are in Doornpoort, Pretoria, which the firm describes as easily accessible via the N1 North.

items.description:
Mathibele Mahlaela Attorneys Inc. is a South African law firm situated in Centurion, Pretoria. The firm describes its approach as results-driven and says it is committed to integrity, honesty, loyalty and client satisfaction. Its commercial and company law work includes contract drafting and review, litigation and arbitration.

Its corporate law services cover regulatory compliance, due diligence, and mergers and acquisitions. Its employment and labour law services cover both employers and employees, including legal representation and the drafting of employment contracts. The firm also handles alternative dispute resolution, including legal representation in contract disputes such as construction contracts at various forums across South Africa.

In estate planning it prepares wills and trusts, and it offers professional estate administration. The firm says its services are tailored to each client's needs.

Maximum Security Services provides CCTV installation, alarm systems and armed response. The company says it focuses on setting up and maintaining security systems so they work optimally and are easy to use. It reports more than 24 years of experience, and its 24-hour control room provides monitoring and response, supported by technical services that keep systems functioning.

Its CCTV offering covers comprehensive camera solutions. Its home security packages combine alarm systems, surveillance cameras and 24/7 monitoring, tailored to each client's specific needs. The company also runs a community CCTV campaign, the Street View Cameras project, which aims to enhance neighbourhood safety.

items.description:
Marketecture Business Management Services is a business management and secretariat company that describes itself as hands-on and focused on client satisfaction. It provides operational and administrative support, including a personalised telephone answering service, support for standing committees and structures, and attendance at executive meetings.

Its secretariat work includes compiling and distributing meeting packs and taking minutes, and providing storage and archive facilities in Pretoria. On the financial side, it manages bank accounts, executes authorised payments, and is responsible for timely submission of audited annual financial statements. Its other services include overseeing governance, compliance and reporting systems, managing the interface with CIPC and other statutory bodies, and compiling reports such as NPO reports. The company also offers event management, marketing, branding and stakeholder engagement services.

MFG Accountants is an accounting firm in Lynnwood, Pretoria, located close to major access routes and to the Menlyn and Hatfield business hubs, and near the University of Pretoria. Although most of its clients are in the Pretoria area, it also serves clients across South Africa.

Its services include accounting, auditing and assurance, cloud accounting solutions, corporate finance, estate work, payroll, SARS and taxation, trust work, and secretarial and support services. The firm says its focus includes improving business efficiency. Its website encourages prospective clients to compare their accountant against the skills, training and experience of a Chartered Accountant, pointing out that anyone can call themselves an accountant without qualifications.

Mhlangawethu Trading offers electrical, air-conditioning and general building services maintenance. Its general maintenance work covers the upkeep of homes and apartment buildings, including repairs to plumbing. Its electrical engineering services include assembling electrical distribution panels, wiring and testing medium and low voltage panels, servicing switchgear, and repairing electrical systems including mini-substations, generators and transformer replacement.

Its air-conditioning work covers new installations, ducting, split and heat pump units, VAV controls, piping and meter installations, as well as maintenance of air-conditioning and refrigeration systems. The company also maintains pump stations, rewinds and installs motors, and carries out plumbing and drainage work, including septic and graywater systems. Its website says its completed work meets quality standards.

Mighty Thor Bakkie Accessories, known as MTBA Pretoria North, sells bakkie accessories and fitments to the public and to dealerships. Its product categories include bonnet scoops, mag wheels (the business says it has 22 to choose from), bumpers, wheel arches, headlamp and tail-lamp covers, and fog covers.

Its fitment centre is staffed by skilled personnel who fit accessories to customers' vehicles, and the business operates a full-featured workshop for this work. The business says it supplies accessories from A to Z and aims for high quality in its fitment work. Its latest videos include a mag wheel feature, and customers who cannot find a part they need can contact the business for help.

Miko Coffee is a coffee business whose Southern African operations began in 2006. It supplies coffee blends, coffee machines and services for corporates, hospitality venues and restaurants.

Its Miko Coffee range is an Italian-style roast, and its Fairtrade offering is the Puro coffee basket. The company also supplies professional espresso equipment, vending machines and filter coffee options, and provides technical service for its machines. Its website describes professional barista training as part of its offering, with the aim of creating passionate coffee ambassadors for clients. Coverage extends to Cape Town, the Garden Route, the West Coast, Gqeberha, East London, Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Rustenburg, Polokwane, Newcastle, the Kruger Park area and Namibia.

Moloto Solutions is a corporate governance and financial management consultancy focused on empowerment, including B-BBEE and other transformation tools. Its B-BBEE consultancy team has verification experience, and it offers a range of services in this area. Its financial consulting covers support for due diligences, fund raising and project management.

Through a structured supplier and enterprise development programme, it helps clients maximise their B-BBEE points. The firm says its team combines experience in empowerment, audit, financial, project and strategic management roles in both private and public sector organisations. It presents itself as a combined service covering empowerment, strategy, financial management and corporate governance, with the aim of saving clients time and cost.

items.description:
Morale Corp provides outsourced HR services for businesses it describes as premium sectors, including IT agencies, medical clusters and specialised consultancies with 10 to 50 professionals. It calls its approach psychology-driven HR, which it says reduces the people-management load on business owners.

The services it describes include all-in-one HR administration, hiring support, and help with staff turnover, labour disputes, and low morale or team conflict. The company says its solutions help clients comply with the Basic Conditions of Employment Act (BCEA) and the Labour Relations Act (LRA), reduce exposure to CCMA disputes and regulatory liability, and return time to owners and managers. Prospective clients can request a 15-minute risk review through the website.

items.description:
Multi-Star Distribution is a broad-based black-empowered supply and distribution company. It supplies IT equipment, medical equipment, office equipment, cleaning items, corporate clothing and industrial supplies to clients across sectors. The company says it sources products from many manufacturers worldwide, and that it checks that quality standards and specifications are met before delivery.

Its stated mission is to become the most efficient broad-based black-empowered supply and distribution company, supplying high-quality products at competitive prices within a reasonable time frame. The business was started by a female entrepreneur who saw a gap for an honest and reliable supplier.

Its clients include security companies, for which it supplies uniforms and security equipment, and Spar stores, for which it supplies IT equipment, cleaning equipment and chemicals. It is also registered on several government supplier platforms.

items.description:
mySolutions is an enterprise software company that says it has operated since 2003 and implements and supports IBM and HCL platforms in South Africa. It describes itself as an IBM certified partner and as the first HCL managed service provider in Africa, with local engineers, ZAR pricing and POPIA-aware deployments. Its specialisations include MIND CTI, UC Analytics, FastWorks, SHEQ, myLegal, HCL Unica, IBM OpenPages for governance and risk, and data and AI services.

The company says it delivers services across South Africa and the SADC region. Its support desk connects customers directly to the engineers who built their systems. It presents its approach as starting with the client's problem and then implementing a platform to solve it.

The National Energy Regulator of South Africa (NERSA) is a regulatory authority established as a juristic person under Section 3 of the National Energy Regulator Act, 2004. Its mandate is to regulate the electricity, piped-gas and petroleum pipelines industries under the Electricity Regulation Act, 2006, the Gas Act, 2001 and the Petroleum Pipelines Act, 2003.

The regulator has nine members, five of them part-time and four full-time, including the Chief Executive Officer, supported by personnel under the CEO's direction. Its stated vision is to be a recognised leader in energy regulation. Its mission is to regulate the energy industry in accordance with government laws, policies, standards and international best practice, in support of sustainable and orderly development.

Its values are passion, spirit of partnership, excellence, innovation, integrity, responsibility, professionalism and pride. The website also sets out the regulatory principles NERSA applies across the three industries it regulates, and it has sections for public hearings, stakeholder workshops, calls for proposals and procurement.

items.description:
North Lawnmowers is a family business that was first established in 1994 and has grown into a comprehensive operation while keeping its community focus. It was later joined by the founder's son, and over the past decade the business has expanded. It sells an extensive range of lawnmowers and garden equipment, and its team gives product advice.

Its workshop has trained staff who handle major and minor repairs on electric, petrol and diesel machines. The business says its customer service is built on professionalism and integrity, with honest and expert advice available on all products and equipment. Its website also includes a products section and a hints and tips page for garden and mower care.

North & West Cleaning Systems was established in December 2011 as a sole proprietorship and registered as a (Pty) Ltd company in July 2012. It started in a small workshop, moved to a larger workshop that year, and in February 2013 expanded into a 200 square metre building with office space, a reception area and a bathroom. The company says its customers are central to everything it does, with the aim of achieving cost-effective, continuous customer satisfaction.

Its vision is to build lifelong customers by listening actively, anticipating their needs and delivering value. It aims to be recognised for reliability, flexibility, responsiveness and commitment to service excellence. Its website lists its products and offers cleaning equipment rentals.

Nova Property Group is part of Nova PropGrow Group Limited, which describes itself as a holding company owning and controlling assets worth in excess of R2.5 billion. The group's commercial property portfolio is maintained and rejuvenated to keep its assets in good condition, and its website also carries commercial property updates, including one on an auction and coverage on Moneyweb. Its residential portfolio concentrates on eight geographical hubs selected for their development and growth.

The group's board has three executive directors and four non-executive directors, which the website describes as a strong, highly skilled board. Its website publishes communiques, press releases, schemes of arrangement, financial statements and statutory documents. It also reports that the group was featured in the April edition of Enterprise Africa.

NovaCloud Africa provides communication and IT solutions for businesses, including managed IT, cloud VPS, high-speed connectivity, VoIP and call centre solutions. Its core capabilities are unified PBX and VoIP systems, enterprise cloud hosting, online cloud backups and recovery, cybersecurity solutions, and monitoring and connectivity. It also offers AI data analytics.

The company names Microsoft, Microsoft 365, Azure, FortiGate, UniFi, Yealink, Wasabi, N-able, Veeam, Nutanix and Acronis among its technology partners. Its website says it has been delivering IT for more than ten years, with real engineers on the ground, service-level agreements and POPIA-compliant service. It says it supports more than 200 growing enterprises. Its office hours are Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 16:00.

Novateur is a fire safety company based in Pretoria that has been operating since 2017. Its installation division complements its consulting services by designing, supplying and installing fire safety systems. These include fire detection, gas suppression and sprinkler systems, with work for warehouses, shopping centres and large businesses across various industries.

The company says a safe business environment is the cornerstone of productivity and success, and that its projects are carried out by talented professionals who want to transform communities, with the community kept in mind. Its services are grouped under fire safety and fire protection systems. The website also features associated partners and clients from the property and facilities management sector.

NuNetwork Corporation (Pty) Ltd, known as NuNet, is a network of service and product providers in the energy, finance and technology industries. Its vision is to integrate the skills, resources and abilities of these industries to create specific solutions for a diversified client base.

Its mission has five parts. The first is networking with specialists and operators in energy, finance and technology across the country and forming working relationships with them. The second is exploiting business opportunities created by integrating the market base the network captures. The third is giving the network access to web and mobile technology and a support system for managing jointly entered projects. The fourth is developing the financial mechanisms needed for those projects, and the fifth is staying true to its core values.

NuSkinnovation Pretoria East is an aesthetic clinic offering skin and laser treatments. The clinic says it has fully qualified Ellipse and Fotona operators, international and locally trained laser specialists, and a somatologist. It states that it owns First World Technology systems and aims to give each client personal attention and build a personal relationship with them.

Its treatments include laser skin rejuvenation, treatment of fine lines and wrinkles, hand rejuvenation, the non-invasive Fotona 4D Timewalker treatment it describes as a lunchtime facelift, LipLase lip plumping, treatment for sagging skin, and skin dullness. The website offers a downloadable price list and online booking. NuSkinnovation also lists franchise locations in Alberton, Cape Town, Centurion, Dainfern, George, Montana, Nelspruit and Paarl.

items.description:
Nyumba Mobile Homes & Offices designs, manufactures and erects prefabricated and modular buildings, and describes itself as a leader in this field in Africa. Each building is custom-designed and built either on a precast concrete slab or on a steel chassis, so it can be moved later. The company says its buildings are guaranteed to last at least 30 years.

Standard features include internal electrical and plumbing fittings, floor covering in ceramic or vinyl tiles, ceilings, aluminium windows with burglar bars and blinds or curtains, and wooden or panel doors with optional security. Customers can choose their own wall and roof colours and select further finishes. Its completed projects include classrooms and schools, offices, ablutions and change houses, hospitals and clinics, kitchens and diners, accommodation, and workshops and warehouses, in South Africa and in countries including Mozambique, Zambia and Swaziland.

OAK Law is a corporate and commercial law firm based in Pretoria that serves clients in South Africa and across Africa. Its practice covers corporate and commercial law, intellectual property law, and conveyancing, notarial and property law.

Its corporate work includes mergers and acquisitions, B-BBEE structures, corporate structuring and restructuring, private equity, commercial agreements, and trusts. The firm also offers dispute resolution and commercial litigation, business rescue and insolvency, franchising, and company secretarial services. The firm says it combines legal expertise with business acumen to deliver pragmatic, efficient and results-driven solutions, and that it aims to exceed client expectations on all fronts.
